entities.name: Carib Presence and Pre-European Abandonment
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Carib (Kalinago) peoples arrived in the later pre-contact period. By the time of European exploration, the island appears to have been largely or completely uninhabited — the indigenous population had departed or been displaced, possibly by Carib raids.
